sources.title: 5.9 原程式、六位置練習、參數與既有抽樣重算
參數與單位的透明算式
sources.details: Two hexadecimal digits per byte give 16^2=256=2^8 values. FP32: 32/8=4 bytes. Default non-block: 264*8+128*8+2*8+8*264=5264; block: 4*8*8+(8*32+32*8)+(32+8)+2*(8+8)=840; total 5264+840=6104 and 6104*4=24416. General defaults: non-block=2*V*D+M*D+2D; block=12D^2+9D. At V=264,M=128,D=64,L=2: 42112+2*49728=141568; 141568*4=566272. All model counts additionally executed; all pure-parameter byte estimates exclude gradients, optimizer/activation state, metadata and allocator overhead.
